title: Backup before export
description: The policy lists backup_a before export, so every night the snapshot holds the export of the day before. The same nights are replayed with the chain in order.
pass_criterion: Inverted: verdict FAILED, exit code 3, one finding on policy/backup.yaml / chain; the drill differs on the export file only and the snapshot's export has yesterday's SHA-256. Chained: verdict OK and the snapshot's export has today's SHA-256.
lesson: One chained runner, in order: a backup taken before the export is a backup of yesterday.
